newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran to support Iranians bidding for Azeri deals.
newsitem.headline: Iran to support Iranians bidding for Azeri deals.

text.p: Iran has told Azerbaijan it would provide credit facilities to Iranian contractors to help them win government projects in the former Soviet republic, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Wednesday.
It said the message was coveyed to Azeri Deputy Prime Minister Abid Sharifov by Iran's ambassador Alireza Bigdeli.

It quoted the ambassador as saying that "in the event Iranian bidders should win any government tender (in Azerbaijan) the Iranian government would offer them credit facilities in their professional support".

"The Azerbaijan official welcomed the participation of Iranian contractors in national tenders...and added that his government would shortly offer a number of tenders for national development projects," IRNA added.

Iran has given Moslem Azerbaijan political support in its long-running conflict with Armenia over the Nagorno-Karabakh enclave. But their ties have been strained because of Azerbaijan's relations with Israel and other issues.
Tehran-Baku ties improved since an Iranian firm last year won a 10 percent stake in a $4 billion foreign consortium to develop Azerbaijan's Shakh-Deniz oilfield in the Caspian.
